newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bital 97 Q2 net profit 115.6 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Bital 97 Q2 net profit 115.6 mln pesos.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Financiero Bital said on Tuesday it posted a net profit of 115.6 million pesos in the second quarter of 1997, up 11.6 percent from the first quarter of the year.
Its bank unit Banco Internacional registered a net profit of 120.2 million pesos in the second quarter, up 21.2 percent from the first quarter of the year, the financial group said in a statement.
Bital said the results were influenced by a change in accounting procedures, the financial group's monetary position, the updating of bank results and the market value of its portfolio.
The release said the bank's capitalization level was 13.5 percent at the end of June compared to 13.6 percent at the end of March.
Bital said past-due loans represented 14.3 percent of its loan portfolio.
Outstanding loans totalled 49.944 billion pesos as of June 30, an increase of 4.9 percent from the end of the first quarter, Bital said.
Reserves to cover bad loans reached 55.1 percent of the past-due total in the quarter, enough to satisfy government requirements.
Past-due loans totalled 7.159 billion pesos, and of that 3.378 billion were from mortgages, Bital said.
